result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: restaurant names and category chips are truncated, and the bottom restaurant card is cut off by the navigation bar.

issues.description: The third restaurant card under 'Fastest near you' has its name truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure horizontal cards fully show names without ellipsis cutoff.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza) is partially cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area inset so list content scrolls fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally; the rightmost chip is clipped and only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious (e.g. peek of next chip) or wrap/adjust spacing so chips are fully visible.

issues.description: Promo banner text contrast is low (light green text on light green background), reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the promo text color to meet WCAG contrast guidelines against the mint background.
